name: @blobatar/solid
description: Solid adapter for blobatar — deterministic geometric avatars.
//exports: Three conditions because Solid's compiler emits different code per target rather than one runtime that branches. `solid` hands the consumer's own `vite-plugin-solid` types-stripped JSX, which is the only way their build and this one agree about hydration markers; `node` is the SSR build, and a consumer who got the DOM build there would render nothing at all; `default` is the DOM build. `scripts/build.ts` produces all three.

scripts.//prepack: Under `check`, turbo owns the build: the `build` task runs once for the whole workspace before any check reads a `dist`. Under `npm pack` and `npm publish` there is no turbo and no ordering, so without this the tarball is whatever `dist` happened to be on disk — stale, from another branch, or absent.

//peerDependencies: `blobatar` is pinned to an exact major, not `^2`. Every package in this set publishes the same version (`.changeset/config.json`), and npm does not enforce that at install time — without the exact range, `@blobatar/solid@3` resolves happily alongside `blobatar@2` and renders a different generation's faces from a package the consumer believes is current. Under ADR-0008 the major names the generation, so a mixed pair is not a version skew, it is the wrong picture. `packages/harness` asserts this range rather than trusting it.
author: Alain
